name: P3 0.4 nozzle
printer_notes: P3 test profile from P3机器切片对接参数摘要.md. T0..T5 identify docks, sharing one extruder motor and heater. XY40..337/Y50..285 and Z0..310 are candidate print bounds, not accepted machine dimensions. Zero nozzle offsets are placeholders pending calibration. Confirm clean persistent tool state manually after first use or errors; never auto-confirm it from G-code. Bed heater and mesh are unverified and omitted. PLA 210 C; current frequency profile is only verified up to 220 C. Retraction, priming, nozzle offsets and the tool return path still require machine acceptance.
machine_start_gcode:
;P3 shared extruder/heater; tool state must already be confirmed by the operator
G90
M83
G28
T[initial_tool]
M109 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_tool]}
G92 E0
